source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Once per battle, the [Rapid Ingress](vsdata:ability/core.rapid-ingress) Stratagem can cost you 0CP. The unit it targets has to arrive more than 8" from every enemy unit and up to 3" from the bearer's unit.

**Designer's Note**: put a Homing Beacon token beside this unit, and take it away after the ability is used.

wargear.designerNote: a token beside the unit marks the unused ability and is removed once it is used
